title: Greek Spicy Fritters with Reblochon Cheese
description: A flavorful twist on traditional fritters, combining the warmth of spices with the creaminess of reblochon cheese, all wrapped up in a crispy Greek-inspired coating.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine the reblochon cheese, tagliere, Greek yogurt, vibrant bell peppers, and spicy jalapeños. Mix well until combined.
3. Add the breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until just combined.
4. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
5. Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown and crispy, flipping halfway through.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the fritters warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
8. For an extra crispy coating, you can chill the fritters in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
9. Be careful when frying, as the oil can be hot and splatters easily.
10. Enjoy your delicious Greek spicy fritters with reblochon cheese!
